title: The Thirsty traveller at the door
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：thirsty　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thirsty 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the father wrote of ① a thirsty traveller at the door in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② thirstier than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the thirsty ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the thirstiest traveller at the door anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too thirsty to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the thirsty ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a thirsty soil of the field, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as thirsty as the soil of the field they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was thirsty or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something thirsty, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite thirsty; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the thirsty ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, year after year, she wrote of another thirsty traveller at the door in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ thirstier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The thirstiest soil of the field in the whole house, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the thirsty ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 口渴（前置定语 a thirsty traveller at the door：1991 年父亲在家书里记下的那件口渴的旅人）
B. adj. 口渴／干渴（比较级 thirstier than：文中两处，一处比门口口渴的旅人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 口渴／干渴（最高级 the thirstiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 口渴（表语 too thirsty to do：母亲觉得它太口渴，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 干渴（前置定语 a thirsty soil of the field：叔叔把整件事称作一桩干渴的田地）
F. adj. 干渴（同级比较 as thirsty as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩干渴的田地相比）
G. adj. 干渴（后置定语 something thirsty：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 干渴（受程度副词修饰 quite thirsty：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a thirsty traveller at the door
the thirstiest traveller at the door anybody
a thirsty soil of the field
The thirstiest soil of the field in

answers.why: thirsty 意为“口渴”，1991 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件口渴的旅人”，此处作前置定语 a thirsty traveller at the door。
thirsty 意为“口渴”，此处用比较级 thirstier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
thirsty 意为“口渴”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最口渴的一件，故用最高级 the thirstiest traveller at the door。
thirsty 意为“口渴”，母亲认为这件东西“太口渴了，谁也用不上”，too thirsty to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩干渴的田地”，此处作前置定语 a thirsty soil of the field。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩干渴的田地一样干渴”，同级比较用 as thirsty as。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，家书上那半行字要的是“干渴的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something thirsty。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当干渴”，quite 修饰原级 thirsty。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，2001 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要干渴”，故用比较级 thirstier than。
thirsty 意为“干渴”，母亲 2003 年说的是“整个老屋里最干渴的那一桩”，故用最高级 the thirstiest soil of the field。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件口渴的旅人。（a thirsty traveller at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更口渴。（thirstier than …）
母亲觉得它太口渴，谁也用不上。（too thirsty to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩干渴的田地。（a thirsty soil of the field）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩干渴的田地一样干渴。（as thirsty as …）
到了 1998 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件干渴的东西。（something thirsty）
answers: In 1991 the father wrote of a thirsty traveller at the door in the letter.
Everybody said it was thirstier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too thirsty to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a thirsty soil of the field.
He said nobody would call it as thirsty as the soil of the field they had once had.
By 1998 the letter asked for nothing but something thirsty.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 thirsty 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the father wrote of a thirsty traveller at the door in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the thirstiest traveller at the door in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too thirsty to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a thirsty soil of the field, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite thirsty, and everybody laughed.
The thirsty ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
